subject: Post-call: context & cost profile for SmartDocs POC
messages:
From: Rafael Mendes <rafael@redwood.com>
To: Lina Park <lina@smartdocs.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 12 Mar 2026 16:15:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call: context & cost profile for SmartDocs POC

Hi Lina —

Thanks again for the call earlier today. Quick recap and a few follow-ups so we can size the POC and hit your target unit economics:

Call highlights
- Primary flow: user uploads docs -> SmartDocs extracts sections -> generates summaries + answer generation (templated prompts)
- Latency sensitivity: <800ms tail preferred for search/summary paths; async OK for longer answer generation
- Security: initial POC can run on Redwood Hosted, later Dedicated or Private for SOC2/compliance

What we need from you (small items)
- Confirm expected monthly active users (MAU) and average daily active users (DAU)
- Share a small sample of the typical request/response payloads (we got a 200-row token sample, thanks) — the attached smartdocs_token_sample.csv is our working copy
- Confirm any hard % of requests that need the larger context windows (8k / 32k / 128k). From the call you estimated a small fraction for very long docs.

Quick pricing qualification questions (will help us give a target $/1M tokens estimate):
1) Target budget band for the early POC (monthly) — rough ranges are fine (e.g., <$5k, $5–15k, $15–50k, >$50k)
2) Ideal $/1M tokens you want us to aim for for the POC (ballpark) — helps balance hosted vs dedicated pathways
3) Expected request volume: rough monthly request count (or average requests/day) and any seasonality spikes

Preliminary profiling notes from our side (based on the sample):
- Avg prompt tokens per request: ~420 tokens (varies by template)
- Avg completion tokens: ~1,050 tokens (higher for long-form answers)
- Token distribution: ~94% fit inside 8k context; ~5% require 32k; ~0.6% require 128k in current sample

Next steps I propose:
- You send a short confirmation with the three items above (MAU/volume, budget band, target $/1M tokens)
- We’ll run a short internal projection (conservative/likely/aggressive scenarios) and return computations showing estimated monthly token volume and three pricing options: Hosted standard, Hosted committed, Dedicated trial (if commit looks attractive)
- Quick 30-min follow-up next week to walk the numbers and lock the POC sizing

Attachments: smartdocs_token_sample.csv (we added a token_count column), initial_usage_estimate.xlsx (blank workbook for you to fill if helpful)

Thanks — looking forward to the numbers.

Best,
Rafael Mendes
Account Executive | Redwood Inference

Rafael —

Thanks for the clear recap. Quick answers below so you can run the projection:

- MAU/DAU: target for POC is ~2,500 MAU, ~250 DAU (early adopter cohort)
- Monthly requests: roughly 15k–30k requests/month; expect growth if conversion is solid
- Budget band: initial POC budget target is in the $10k–$25k/month range
- Target $/1M tokens: we’d like to see something in the $100–$200 per 1M tokens range for hosted pricing (ballpark)
- Context windows: based on our doc corpus — ~92–96% will be under 8k, ~3–7% will need 32k, and only a handful (~0.2–1%) will need 128k.

I added a few clarifying notes on the sample: average prompt looks closer to 450 tokens once you include system/context tokenization; completion averages ~1,200 on long answers. I attached an internal note but left the sample you sent as-is.

Can you include a simple worked example in your projection showing how you compute monthly tokens from requests? Also include hosted vs committed vs dedicated price bands so we can see tradeoffs.

If you can send numbers by Monday EOD PST we’ll sync on Tuesday for 30 mins.

Cheers,
Lina Park
Head of Product | SmartDocs AI
lina@smartdocs.ai

Subject: Re: Post-call: context & cost profile for SmartDocs POC

Thanks Lina — this is very helpful. Below are the projections + worked examples (conservative / expected / aggressive) using the ranges you provided and the sample-adjusted token averages. I’m also including suggested $/1M token bands and a recommended next-step for the POC.

How we compute tokens (worked example)
- Monthly tokens = monthly_requests * (avg_prompt_tokens + avg_completion_tokens)
- Convert to millions: monthly_tokens_m = monthly_tokens / 1,000,000

Inputs we used (from sample + your confirmation)
- Avg prompt tokens: 450
- Avg completion tokens: 1,200
- Token per request: 1,650 tokens (450 + 1,200)

Scenarios (requests/month -> monthly_tokens_m -> rough cost buckets)
1) Conservative: 15k reqs/month
   - monthly tokens = 15,000 * 1,650 = 24,750,000 tokens -> 24.75M tokens
2) Expected: 22.5k reqs/month (midpoint)
   - monthly tokens = 22,500 * 1,650 = 37,125,000 tokens -> 37.125M tokens
3) Aggressive: 30k reqs/month
   - monthly tokens = 30,000 * 1,650 = 49,500,000 tokens -> 49.5M tokens

Now apply pricing bands. Below are example hosted price bands we can offer for the POC (illustrative; final depends on model family & commit):
- Hosted standard: $250 per 1M tokens (short-term, no commit)
- Hosted committed: $150 per 1M tokens (3-month commit, modest volume)
- Dedicated trial (reserved pool): equivalent ~$100 per 1M tokens (requires small reserved capacity/min commitment)

Estimated monthly cost (by scenario)
- Conservative (24.75M tokens)
  - Hosted standard: 24.75 * $250 = $6,187.50
  - Hosted committed: 24.75 * $150 = $3,712.50
  - Dedicated trial: 24.75 * $100 = $2,475.00

- Expected (37.125M tokens)
  - Hosted standard: 37.125 * $250 = $9,281.25
  - Hosted committed: 37.125 * $150 = $5,568.75
  - Dedicated trial: 37.125 * $100 = $3,712.50

- Aggressive (49.5M tokens)
  - Hosted standard: 49.5 * $250 = $12,375.00
  - Hosted committed: 49.5 * $150 = $7,425.00
  - Dedicated trial: 49.5 * $100 = $4,950.00

Context-window uplift / 32k / 128k requests
- For the small % that require 32k or 128k, we model a multiplier for compute/price because of longer seq lengths and memory footprint (approx +40% cost for 32k requests, +150% for 128k requests). Using your distribution (assume expected case):
  - 37.125M total tokens baseline
  - If 5% of requests are 32k, those request tokens are larger; we estimate an uplift of ~+40% on the per-request cost for that slice (we can run exact per-rep tokenization once you provide a trace)
  - If 0.5% are 128k, uplift ~+150%

Worked sample including uplift (expected case):
- Baseline cost (hosted committed): 37.125M * $150 = $5,568.75
- 5% 32k uplift delta: 0.05 * 37.125M * $150 * 0.40 = ~$111.38
- 0.5% 128k uplift delta: 0.005 * 37.125M * $150 * 1.50 = ~$416.72
- Adjusted hosted committed estimate: ~$5,568.75 + $111.38 + $416.72 = ~$6,096.85

Notes on the bands and levers
- If the $100–$200 per 1M tokens is your goal, the Hosted Committed band at $150/1M looks aligned for the POC. Dedicated (reserved capacity) can get you into the ~$100/1M range with a small monthly reservation.
- We can use batching, KV caching for templates, and response-length caps to reduce effective token consumption (we’ll identify candidates once we see traces)

Recommended next steps
1) Agree on POC commit band (suggest Hosted Committed at $150/1M for a 3-month trial) or a small Dedicated trial if you prefer the predictable cost profile
2) Share 2–3 representative request/response traces (we’ll use these to run exact cost sims and identify caching opportunities)
3) Schedule a 30-min call Tues 10–10:30am PT to walk the final numbers and sign the POC order form

I’ll attach a short pdf with the same worked examples (rdwd_pricing_estimate_v1.pdf) and a one-page POC checklist. If agreeable, Marissa will follow up on the POC contract language and Ben can scope Dedicated sizing if we go that route.

Call to action: can you confirm which band you prefer (Hosted Committed at $150/1M or Dedicated trial) and share the 2–3 traces by Monday EOD?

Thanks — looking forward to locking this in.

Best,
